paper_title: Constraints on axion-like particles from X-ray observations of Hydra galaxy cluster
notes: Astrophysical bound from X-ray spectral irregularities of Hydra A. Main quoted limit g<8.3e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a < 7e-12 eV (mass-independent below this). Above ~7e-12 eV limit weakens (rises as m_a^2, with a small feature near 8e-12 eV where m_a~m_gamma). Points above 7e-12 eV are approximate reads from Fig. 4 exclusion contour. Not a DM haloscope, so no local density assumed. | selector: text (sole candidate)
